title: The pendulum clock

data.source: Damped pendulum with a fixed energy dose at each pass through the bottom (Kelvin-Andronov escapement model), RK4

prediction: After any disturbance the swing returns to its steady size by one fixed fraction per tick; a ratio fitted on a 2 % disturbance predicts recovery from a halved swing and a 50 % bigger swing within 1 % of the steady swing.
baseline: The standard escapement model: a damped pendulum given a fixed dose of energy at each tick, which also predicts how the tick rate changes with swing size.
why: Read as swing angle, one fixed ratio does not predict a big disturbance. Read as swing energy it does, but that is the standard escapement map itself. CRR does not say which reading to use, and it says nothing about the clock running fast.
